calls.title: Website Image Planning
calls.summary: The team convened to discuss strategies for enhancing the website's integrations content and design alignment. They decided to eliminate a separate integrations page in favor of consolidating crucial content within the documentation to boost SEO and minimize maintenance. Karen Henke stressed the importance of up-to-date integration information being primarily sourced from the docs. The meeting also addressed the need for a streamlined content review process, with final drafts for product pages due Monday to facilitate image planning. Additionally, Kari Kay proposed alternative layout components to improve content-image integration across various page types. The group emphasized a focus on simple visuals due to resource limitations and aimed to replace larger meetings with smaller, more focused sessions to enhance collaboration.
calls.keywords: Integrations Page, SEO, Content Management, Image Planning, Platform vs Product Pages, Website Design
